entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 111.2 +/- 3.9 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, HV 878: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 111.2 +/- 3.9 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 77,361,840 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5500 +/- 125 K from Groenewegen & Lub (2023), A&A 676, A136, VizieR J/A+A/676/A136/table1, Name=LMC0501, columns Teffp, e_Teffp: Teff 5500 +/- 125 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.07559). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
